The modifications in the `qcom_nandc.c` file are related to the handling of code words in the context of the QPIC V2 NAND controller. The introduction of the `raw_cw` variable allows the code to adaptively determine the correct code word to read based on whether the QPIC version is V2 or not. This change ensures that the correct last code word is read from the separate register introduced in QPIC V2, thereby fixing the bug related to reading the last code word incorrectly when the number of code words is set to 1. The updates to the function calls reflect this new logic, ensuring that the correct values are used in the read operations.

```c
update_rw_regs(host, 1, true, raw_cw);
config_nand_cw_read(chip, false, raw_cw);
```
